incidentDescription: Credential-stuffing attempt against the sign-in page from a rotating set of addresses.

milestones.milestoneDescription: Rate limit lowered and offending address ranges blocked.
Sign-in logs reviewed; no successful authentication from the attacking ranges.
Affected agency confirmed it saw no unusual activity.

potentialImpact.evaluationNotes: Rated N2 at detection (internet-reachable, likely exploitable); N0 once every attempt was confirmed failed.

functionalImpact: None: sign-in stayed available and no agency account was accessed.
recoveryPlan: No recovery needed; rate-limit and bot rules stay in place and are reviewed monthly.
observedActivity: About 40,000 sign-in attempts over 30 minutes using leaked credential lists; every attempt failed at the phishing-resistant MFA step.
rootCause: Credential lists leaked from an unrelated third-party breach.
responseAndRecoveryActivities: Blocked the ranges, lowered the rate limit, confirmed no compromise, notified the affected agency.
